sonnet.problem: The question asks why Pharaoh was given the dream in two versions, and the right answer says God decreed it. Verse 32 runs the other way: because the dream came in two versions, the matter is decreed by God. The card reverses the connection and gives a reason for the two versions that the text never states.
sonnet.rule: He never adds why someone did, said or thought something unless the text says why. / Leave open what the text leaves open: Who is being spoken to, why, or how two things connect.
